channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Quentin Grimes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Quentin Grimes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JJ Redick on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
Quentin Grimes, who had started the first four preseason games and had been solid in his role, was not among them.

“I know that there’s a chance Quentin is gonna have an opportunity to start,”

JJ Redick on Quentin Grimes, Oct 17, 2026. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: JJ Redick on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
Redick, not surprisingly, felt compelled to clarify the comment.

“When I said the pieces fit, that’s more about having depth, having multiple ballhandlers besides Luka and AR (in newcomers Colin Sexton and Quentin Grimes), having more shooting, more volume shooting, having an elite rim protector — the combination of all those pieces,”

JJ Redick on Quentin Grimes, Oct 8, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Quentin Grimes:

“He did everything we asked. He’s a pro… his ability defensively and offensively to help us, we’re going to miss him.”

Jason Kidd on Quentin Grimes, Feb 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @SixersAdam.

item.title: Monty Williams on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
Monty on Grimes:

“Troy & I talked about it this morning. If you only looked at the shooting, you would be a bit disheartened, but if you look at his game as a whole, I thought he was solid. Defensively, he was pretty good. Getting over screens & guarding the ball, playing in .5.”

Monty Williams on Quentin Grimes, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
“Quintin Grimes, he can't get 6 3s up. He doesn't dribble at all. He doesn't have any free throws on the season. He doesn't have any assists it feels like, but he's getting 3s up? That's the stuff we can't have. It's frustrating.”

Kevin Durant on Quentin Grimes, Dec 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
“I look at how the unit is functioning. And so, I would say tonight, we didn’t play well, and to put it on Quentin is not fair,”

Tom Thibodeau on Quentin Grimes, Dec 6, 2023. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
Jalen Brunson said Thursday.

“Guys step up but as a team we had to step up together. We have a lot of great players on this team that can do a lot of great things. Obviously we want Quentin to come back when he’s healthy, when he’s ready, whatever goes on, but I think for us we all know what we have to do.”

Jalen Brunson on Quentin Grimes, Nov 17, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Quentin Grimes, Immanuel Quickley
item.description:
“That’s what I like about Quentin. He’s played long minutes, he’s played short minutes. You can start him, you can bring him off the bench and he’s going to be the same every day. We’ve got a bunch of guys — [Immanuel Quickley is] the same way. “I’ve mentioned this before; Even though Quick and Josh, even though they’re not starting, I view them as starters. So those guys will be rotating in and out and I think it keeps them where we can play a high-energy game. I think that’s a plus for us.”

Tom Thibodeau on Quentin Grimes, Immanuel Quickley, Feb 28, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: RJ Barrett on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
“Defense has really just picked up, making a conscious effort, especially guys like Deuce and Quentin, Quick, just ball-hawking,”

RJ Barrett on Quentin Grimes, Dec 12, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
“I think Quentin and Deuce have added a lot, but I also don’t wanna take away from what the other guys have done,”

Tom Thibodeau on Quentin Grimes, Dec 12, 2022. Source: New York Post.
